texts: Some Keepers keep notebooks of moth-counts and weather notes.
A Keeper's notebook passes to the heir with the station.

fields.sentence: Some Keepers keep notebooks of moth-counts and weather notes.

q1_issues.issue: The restrictive of-phrase is attached to the bare kind symbol `notebook`, so it asserts of notebooks at large that they are of moth-counts — a kind-level claim no word in the sentence puts there (the restriction belongs on the specific notebooks these keepers keep).
Same problem for the second conjunct: `(Of notebook weather_note)` predicates the restriction of the kind `notebook` rather than of the referents.

`CardinalityPhrase` is scoped to vague phrases that count things (a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds / a lot of), normalized to a canonical lexicon string; "some" is an existential determiner with no listed count reading.

q2_gaps: quantity encoding for the determiner "some" over a plural — it is absent from the quantifier strength dial (all/most/a lot of/many/few/no), absent from the vague-count list, and the Existential section's "some X" case supplies only a witness, so neither a strength, a CardinalityPhrase nor a QuantifierPhrase companion is licensed for it

a content / "about" of-phrase on a non-nominalization common noun ("notebooks of moth-counts") — the genitive rule explicitly excludes about-phrases ("a photo of Mary") from Possession, and the noun has no underlying verb, so the nominalization-object oblique does not apply either; no replacement encoding is stated

a capitalized plural kind-word under a quantifier ("Some Keepers") — the capitalized-common-noun default is declared singular-collective only, while the plural branch covers only a label referring as a name ("the Wrens"), leaving a quantified capitalized plural unaddressed
review.notes: Group witness + group event + per-member distribution rule for a distributive predicate, and the solid-spelling/hyphenated compound decompositions (notebook→book, moth_count→count, weather_note→note, noun modifiers left unexposed), all match the instruction set. The defect is the bearer of the two `Of` atoms, not the head.

issues.reason: (Of notebook moth_count) predicates the restriction of the bare KIND notebook, asserting that notebooks at large are of moth-counts - a false kind-level claim no word of the sentence puts there (Core patterns: point at the words that put the atom there).

(Of notebook weather_note) is the same falsehood on the second conjunct: the kind notebook is asserted to stand in the Of relation to weather notes, which the sentence says only of the notebooks these keepers keep.

CardinalityPhrase is scoped to vague phrases that COUNT things ("use CardinalityPhrase only when the phrase counts things"), normalized to the canonical lexicon string (a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds / a lot of); the existential determiner "some" counts nothing and is handled by the Existential section, so the atom puts a non-lexicon string into a slot seeded rules read as a numeric bound.

gaps_confirmed: Quantity encoding for the plural determiner "some": absent from the quantifier-strength dial (all/most/a lot of/many/few/no), absent from the vague-count lexicon, and the Existential section's "some X" case supplies only a witness - so neither a strength, a CardinalityPhrase nor a QuantifierPhrase companion is licensed for it.

A content / about of-phrase on a non-nominalization common noun ("notebooks of moth-counts"): the genitive rule excludes about-phrases from Possession and the noun has no underlying verb, so the nominalization-object oblique does not apply either; no replacement encoding is stated.

A capitalized plural kind-word under a quantifier ("Some Keepers"): the capitalized-common-noun default is declared singular-collective only and the plural branch covers only a label referring as a name ("the Wrens"), leaving a quantified capitalized plural unaddressed.
new_gaps: A restrictively modified bare-plural object in a habitual clause ("keep notebooks of moth-counts and weather notes"): the bare kind filler is the licensed filler for a non-specific object, but a bare kind symbol has no referent to carry the restriction, and nothing states whether the restriction forces an existential group witness for the object (and a per-member Skolem group inside the distribution rule) instead. A licensed form would need to hold the restriction on the notebooks actually kept without claiming it of the kind.
adjudication.defect_summary: For the two Of atoms the compliant form moves the restriction off the kind and onto the referents - a group witness as the Theme, (GroupOf sk_notebook_1 notebook) (Of sk_notebook_1 moth_count) (Of sk_notebook_1 weather_note), with the distribution rule carrying a per-member Skolem group (sk_notebook $x) bearing the same Of atoms (the dependent-existential pattern of "every student read some book"); for "some" NO compliant form is licensed - the determiner has no strength band, no vague-count reading and no partitive "of the" wording - so the compliant parse emits no quantity atom at all and records the gap.
adjudication.notes: The group witness, group event and per-member distribution rule for the distributive predicate, and the compound decompositions (notebook to book, moth_count to count, weather_note to note, with the noun modifiers unexposed), all conform; the Of head itself is licensed - only its bearer is wrong.

fields.sentence: A Keeper's notebook passes to the heir with the station.

q2_gaps: inanimate accompaniment 'with' PP (an entity that transfers along with the theme) — the 'with'-split offers only CoAgent (explicitly animate co-participant) or Instrument (means), and the preposition-named oblique is framed for PPs answering where/when/how or naming what the activity is about, so accompaniment reaches (With <event> …) only by extension
review.notes: Indefinite 'a Keeper's notebook' correctly stays a witness rather than a generic rule (indefinite + verbal predicate), the document subject correctly takes Theme as un-powered relocation, and 'to the heir' correctly takes Recipient rather than a spatial Goal; capitalized 'Keeper' is handled as a common noun with no Name atom.
